public_spec:
Title: Refund function with no double refund

Behavior requirements:
- refund amount must be positive
- refund amount must not exceed the original payment amount
- refunds are only allowed for valid, non-cancelled orders
- an order cannot be refunded more than once for the same paid amount
- each refund request is linked to a single order and a single paid amount
- if an order has already been refunded for a given amount, subsequent refunds for that amount are rejected
- the system tracks refunded_total per order and validates new refunds against remaining refundable amount

Edge cases:
- refund request equals the original payment amount (full refund) on a valid order
- partial refunds across multiple refund requests for the same order
- refund request for a cancelled or invalid order
- refund request with amount zero or negative
- concurrent refund requests hitting the same order simultaneously
- order with multiple payment chunks or refunds should not allow double refund of any chunk
- rounding issues when amounts involve fractions of the smallest currency unit

Acceptance criteria:
- refund is rejected if order is invalid or cancelled
- refund amount > 0
- refund amount <= original_payment_amount
- no refund processed if same order/payment amount has already been refunded
- refunded_total for the order is updated correctly after each successful refund
- system indicates exactly one of: success with updated refunded_total, or failure with a clear reason (e.g., double refund, over-refund, invalid order)

Non-goals:
- implementing business logic unrelated to refunds (e.g., purchase flow, checkout validation)
- automatic refunds without explicit request
- support for currency conversion or multi-currency refunds beyond the original payment currency

Testable assertions:
- given a valid order with original_payment of X, a refund request of Y (0 < Y <= X) succeeds and refunded_total becomes Y
- subsequent refund requests for the same order with any amount > 0 fail if they would cause total refunds to exceed original_payment
- refund request for an invalid or cancelled order fails
- refund request with amount 0 or negative fails
- concurrent identical refund requests for the same order and amount fail safely without double-refunding
